metadata.title: Raksha Alert Engine Historical Replay and Synthetic Scenario Report

notes: Descriptive replay only: 0 official disaster events confirmed in Anand rabi wheat 2020-2025.
TC-007 early warning detection passes strictly on the labelled synthetic stress scenario.
No claim of early warning validation on real historical data.

alerts.headline: Early-season vegetation vigor decline (39.8% drop below plot prior baseline)
alerts.detail: At Jan 15, plot ANAND_WHEAT_01 recorded NDVI 0.421, falling 39.8% below its own historical baseline (0.700) on this calendar date, indicating in-season vegetative drag and support needed.
alerts.supportive_action: Schedule supportive field visit to verify plot moisture and canopy vigor; check whether PMFBY crop insurance claim assistance or irrigation support is needed.
